headlines.title: Accenture Is Up 33% in a Month but Still Down 2% This Year. Is the Stock Cheap?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAccenture (ACN:NYSE) stock is up 37% in the past month but still up 2% in 2026. Even after the rally, Accenture still looks cheap against its own history, at 18x forward earnings against a 10-year average of 24x.

headlines.title: Mondelez and Accenture partner to incorporate AI into order-to-cash
headlines.summary: Mondelez (MDLZ) and Accenture (ACN) are collaborating to transform Mondelez’s end-to-end Order-to-Cash process through agentic AI, and integration of new technologies. The transformation is designed to simplify operations, reimagine the customer experience, and enhance customer financial performance. Order-to-Cash spans every stage from order placement through payment collection and plays a critical role in customer experience, revenue generation and cash flow.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
